description.value: Sushi Sen is a Japanese sushi restaurant situated in Garibaldi Highlands, a neighbourhood east of downtown Squamish along the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The restaurant offers both dine-in and online ordering, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area. OSM records it as wheelchair accessible.

The website corroborates the URL and provides address and phone not present in OSM.
